title: TNT's Trims+
description: A simple resource pack to change some trims and pallets of Minecraft.
body:
TNT's Trims+ aims to fix some small and big problems with minecraft's trims and improve upon already good ones.

So far:
Dune trim, all pieces of armor
Pack logo (placeholder)

Roadmap:
Better logo
Coast trim (its rly bad right now)
Silence boots
Snout
Rib
Spire
Eye (dont worry the chestplate will be the same)
